dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' shaped structures exhibit sharp, irregular high-intensity perimeters. The gradient transitions abruptly from a dark base (approx. 0-20% intensity) to a high-intensity white/grey perimeter (approx. 80-95% intensity), with a secondary gradient transition to a moderately dark interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the upper dorsal-lateral area and interspersed between larger annuli. These clusters lack a defined internal gradient or central void.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary geometric relationship is visible as a roughly equilateral triangle formed by the centroids of three centrally-located prominent annuli. A secondary, elongated quadrilateral is formed by four annuli positioned towards the posterior-lateral region.
